completion_notes: Added TaichiCodegenFacade class to taichi_printer.py (128 lines appended after existing emit() — pure tail addition). 13 thin-delegation methods (make_context, preamble, constants, field_declarations, constitutive_update, internal_force_kernel, tangent_matvec_kernel, newton_driver, explicit_driver, validate_mesh, postprocess, main, emit_all). Each method body = single delegation call, zero logic. Façade exported from mechdsl.codegen via __init__.py (__all__ = ['ExperimentalBackendWarning', 'TaichiCodegenFacade', 'compile']). Snapshot equality test confirms emit(bundle) == facade.emit_all(bundle) byte-for-byte. Forbidden surfaces (mfem_printer.py, moose_printer.py, mechdsl/__init__.py) byte-identical to P5-2 baseline. Patch (post-Gate-B) added 8 per-method delegation tests covering all remaining façade methods (internal_force_kernel, tangent_matvec_kernel, newton_driver, explicit_driver, validate_mesh, postprocess, main, make_context); ExperimentalBackendWarning added to __all__ to match the documented public-surface convention. Test count rose 19 → 27. Three minor Gate-B notes deferred to Plan-B (façade docstring usage example explicit-path coverage, validate_mesh class-body ordering vs emit() lifecycle, inspect.signature exact-param pinning) — all stylistic, no behavioural impact.
